title: Lockup word unfold over still footage
summary: A small mark and one-word wordmark sit centred on a full-bleed travel plate; a second, lighter word unfolds to the right as the lockup re-centres, holds, then folds back. Quiet, loopable brand sting.
use_when: A brand whose short name expands to a longer name or category (name + descriptor)
A loopable 5 s sting over hero photography or a calm footage plate
Silent autoplay intro where only the mark has to register
Travel, mobility or hospitality identities with strong imagery

look.type_style: geometric grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; first word medium weight white, second word light weight white at ~75 % opacity; cap height ~5 % H; mark = outlined rounded rectangle ~8 % H, stroke ~1 % H

sfx.event: second word folds back behind the first

structure.shot: full-bleed aerial still of a jet fuselage over dark sea; small mark + one-word wordmark centred on the fuselage
structure.camera: static (plate does not move: motion diff 0.00-0.02, zoom 0.01-0.02 %/s)
structure.motion: none: short lockup holds from frame 0 (no entrance), 35 fr

structure.shot: second word (descriptor, 1 word, lighter weight) unfolds to the right of the first; whole lockup slides left to stay centred
structure.motion: lockup x shift ~-85 px@1250 (~-130 px@1920) on easings.outExpo 17 fr (f35-f52); second word letters fade in left to right, ~1 fr per letter, opacity 0 -> 0.75, starting under the end of the first word

structure.shot: full two-word lockup centred on the plate
second word folds back: it slides left under the first word and fades right to left; lockup re-centres on the short form
structure.motion: reverse of row 2, faster: second word x slides into the first word and fades, last letters out last; lockup x shift ~+85 px@1250 on easings.inOutSine 12 fr (f105-f117)

structure.shot: short lockup holds, identical to frame 0 so the clip loops

params.brand: any brand.json: logo mark, wordmark font, fg colour for the lockup
params.content.name: short brand word shown alone at start and end
params.content.extension: one descriptor word that unfolds after the name (lighter weight, ~75 % opacity)
params.content.footage: full-bleed still or calm clip behind the lockup, mid-tone area at frame centre
params.timing.unfoldAt: frame the unfold starts (default 35 at 30 fps)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: Measured from 30 fps strips at t=1.00 and t=3.30: unfold f35-f52 (17 fr), fold f105-f117 (12 fr); first and last frame match (loopable). The background plate is effectively a still (motion diff <= 0.02). No URL or CTA: end-card is used loosely for the held lockup. Proposed term (not in vocabulary): wordmark-unfold. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent).
